Normal startup can then overwrite that content on a later save.

blocking and original-byte preservation for both malformed forms.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use defaults for null GUI preferences
commitResults.messageBody:
A parsed null GUI setting bypasses preference-reading fallback and
crashes model initialization.

Restore default GUI settings before saving preferences or copying them
into the model, while retaining valid saved settings and client data.

UTF-8 conversion can replace an accepted lone surrogate with a question
mark, changing an unrelated field during an ordinary save.

Encode the complete text strictly before opening the destination. An
encoding error then follows the existing save-failure path without
changing live data or persisted bytes. Retain valid supplementary text.

Independent app instances can overwrite changes saved by another window.

Compare each loaded file snapshot under a cooperative writer lock before
replacing it, so stale saves fail without publishing proposed data. Keep
reads available and document how to reload before retrying.
